name: realfavicon-mcp
description: Generate and audit favicon sets via RealFaviconGenerator. Bundles the realfavicon-mcp MCP server (realfavicon_generate, realfavicon_check, realfavicon_changelog) and a favicons skill that drives it. Requires Bun >= 1.3 on PATH.

args: cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && bun install --frozen-lockfile 1>&2 && exec bun src/index.ts
